title: Best Cat Litter (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.

verdict.line: Picture a busy apartment where two cats use the same box. World’s Best Cat Litter keeps the box odor‑free, clumps well, and stays clean longer than clay. The main catch is that it can be more expensive per pound.
